The shelf is filled with various household items including ceramic spoons, bowls, and patterned dishes. The lighting is bright and indoor-focused, highlighting the texture of the wood and the glossy finish of the tiles. (2) The hand holds up several different Mahjong tiles, showing the intricate designs on the front and rotating them to reveal a yellow-colored back with a price tag attached. The setting remains the retail environment with visible shelves of towels and other goods in the background. (3) A man with glasses and dyed hair appears, smiling and laughing as he interacts with the tiles. The camera then focuses on the back of one tile, revealing a small hole in the center, which identifies the object as a chopstick rest rather than a standard game tile. (4) The scene shifts to a hotpot restaurant environment. Hands are seen placing several Mahjong chopstick rests on a table next to a boiling hotpot divided into two sections. A woman with long blonde hair and a brown top is seated at the table, smiling directly at the camera while holding one of the tiles.
